policies.name: staff_coverage_allocations_mutate_ops
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_roles ur
  WHERE ((ur.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (ur.org_id = staff_coverage_allocations.org_id) AND (ur.role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text, 'ops'::text])))))
policies.with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_roles ur
  WHERE ((ur.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (ur.org_id = staff_coverage_allocations.org_id) AND (ur.role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text, 'ops'::text])))))

policies.name: staff_coverage_allocations_select_org
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_roles ur
  WHERE ((ur.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (ur.org_id = staff_coverage_allocations.org_id))))

index_defs.name: staff_coverage_allocations_employment_date_idx
index_defs.def: CREATE INDEX staff_coverage_allocations_employment_date_idx ON public.staff_coverage_allocations USING btree (org_id, employment_id, service_date) WHERE (lifecycle_state = 'active'::text)

index_defs.name: staff_coverage_allocations_lineage_idx
index_defs.def: CREATE INDEX staff_coverage_allocations_lineage_idx ON public.staff_coverage_allocations USING btree (lineage_root_id)

index_defs.name: staff_coverage_allocations_no_overlap
index_defs.def: CREATE INDEX staff_coverage_allocations_no_overlap ON public.staff_coverage_allocations USING gist (employment_id, service_date, int4range((((EXTRACT(hour FROM start_time) * (60)::numeric) + EXTRACT(minute FROM start_time)))::integer, (((EXTRACT(hour FROM end_time) * (60)::numeric) + EXTRACT(minute FROM end_time)))::integer)) WHERE (lifecycle_state = 'active'::text)

index_defs.name: staff_coverage_allocations_pkey
index_defs.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX staff_coverage_allocations_pkey ON public.staff_coverage_allocations USING btree (id)

index_defs.name: staff_coverage_allocations_room_date_idx
index_defs.def: CREATE INDEX staff_coverage_allocations_room_date_idx ON public.staff_coverage_allocations USING btree (org_id, room_location_id, service_date) WHERE ((lifecycle_state = 'active'::text) AND (room_location_id IS NOT NULL))

index_defs.name: staff_coverage_allocations_site_date_idx
index_defs.def: CREATE INDEX staff_coverage_allocations_site_date_idx ON public.staff_coverage_allocations USING btree (org_id, site_location_id, service_date) WHERE (lifecycle_state = 'active'::text)

rows.transition_check: CHECK ((((supersedes_coverage_id IS NULL) AND (transition_type IS NULL)) OR ((supersedes_coverage_id IS NOT NULL) AND (transition_type = ANY (ARRAY['revision'::text, 'correction'::text])))))
